subject: regional-telugu
title: Telugu — Set 2
description: Common phrases, nature words, and question words

questions.question: What does 'పుస్తకం' (Pustakam) mean?
questions.explanation: 'పుస్తకం' means book in Telugu. It comes from Sanskrit 'పుస్తకమ్'.

questions.question: What does 'సూర్యుడు' (Suryudu) mean?
questions.explanation: 'సూర్యుడు' means Sun in Telugu. Related to Sanskrit 'సూర్యః'.

questions.question: What does 'వర్షం' (Varsham) mean?
questions.explanation: 'వర్షం' means rain in Telugu. 'వర్షాకాలం' = rainy season.

questions.question: What does 'మిత్రుడు' (Mitrudu) mean?
questions.explanation: 'మిత్రుడు' means friend (male) in Telugu. 'మిత్రురాలు' for female friend.

questions.question: How do you say 'two' in Telugu?
What does 'చెట్టు' (Chettu) mean?
questions.explanation: 'చెట్టు' means tree in Telugu. 'చెట్లు' is the plural (trees).

questions.question: What does 'రాత్రి' (Raathri) mean?
questions.explanation: 'రాత్రి' means night in Telugu. 'ఉదయం' = morning, 'సాయంత్రం' = evening.

questions.question: What does 'ఏమిటి' (Emiti) mean?
questions.explanation: 'ఏమిటి' means What in Telugu. It is a very common question word.

questions.question: In which Indian states is Telugu widely spoken?
questions.explanation: Telugu is the official language of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. It is one of India's classical languages.
